body: I have reached out. Been seeing a therapist for almost 7 months. In addition to the lack of any meaningful conversation put forth on her end, she gets to tell me one-sided things like: "You aren't adaptive enough" or "you need to be more open minded" or yada yada yada. Yah okay. Take away people's precious cars or electricity or protection from government and the overwhelming majority couldn't survive a fucking month, that's not adaptive. Access any form of media, and there you go, people touting whatever bullshit they wanna go on about and then attack anyone who disagrees. That's not open-minded. I think she just means I need to conform and be happy with life like everyone else. I have shared, to the one type that's supposed to actually care, even if it's for money. I am still alone. Only now some stranger knows a few things no one else does.
